about: Battle of Readers (Henry, Nov 19; replaces Reading Island): the shared Battle engine with a story per round (games/shared/stories.json). hidden = the hidden bonuses (2 per round). Only slides and bonuses live here.

intro.title: Battle of Readers
text: Each round: read a short story together.
Then answer 5 questions. Your team writes each answer on ONE board.

intro.title: Read carefully!
text: When the questions start, the story goes away.
Your teacher can show it again with 📖 Story.

intro.title: 3 kinds of questions
text: Write T or F, a short answer, or the correct word.

intro.title: Check together
text: After 5 questions, we check every answer together.

intro.title: Count your points
text: 1 point for each right answer, plus your bonuses.
Tell your teacher your team’s total.

hidden.name: Golden Question
hidden.text: Question {n} was secretly worth double! Right? +1 more.

hidden.name: Comeback
hidden.text: The team in last place gets +2!

hidden.name: Neatest Board
hidden.text: Your teacher picks the neatest board: +2!

hidden.name: Spelling Star
hidden.text: Every word on your board spelled right? +2!

hidden.name: Full Sentence
hidden.text: One answer written as a full sentence? +1!

hidden.name: Story Detective
hidden.text: Tell the class one more detail from the story: +1!

hidden.name: Remember the Title
hidden.text: Write the story’s title from memory: +1!

hidden.name: Lucky Letter
hidden.text: +1 for each right answer that starts with the letter {letter}!
